latest.title: POC GFAP for brain haemorrhage in coma
latest.finding: POC GFAP detected ICH with 97.0% sensitivity (95% CI 84.2–99.9%) and AUC 0.94; ICH was present in 51% of patients and 30-day survival was 46%.

latest.title: Every minute counts: early bystander CPR
latest.finding: Overall bystander CPR was stable (58.7% vs 58.6%), but early initiation fell during the pandemic (aHR 0.96); CPR started at 0–3 min carried aOR 3.27 for favourable neurological outcome at 1 month versus >10 min.

latest.title: Commotio cordis outcomes hinge on fast AED
latest.finding: Among 15 commotio cordis cases, AED pads were applied in 93%, shocks in 87%, and 80% achieved favourable neurological outcome; among the other 15 external-cause cases, shocks were rare (7%) and just 7% had favourable outcomes.

latest.title: Prehospital qSOFA adds a little prognostic signal
latest.finding: Within ED triage strata, a prehospital qSOFA ≥2 roughly doubled the odds of 30-day death (aOR 2.06 triage-negative, 1.84 triage-positive), but added only 0.007 AUC beyond arrival vitals and labs.
